text.en: On a sunny day your shadow follows you. In the evening it grows long. Light and shadows are linked, and mirrors can send light back.

Luminous objects make their own light, such as the Sun, a torch and a candle. Non-luminous objects like the Moon only reflect light.
Transparent materials let light pass fully. Translucent ones let some pass. Opaque ones block light. Light travels in straight lines.
A shadow forms when an opaque object blocks light. It is dark and has the same shape as the object. A shadow gets bigger when the object is close to the light and smaller when the object is far. A pinhole camera uses a tiny hole to make an upside-down image on a screen because light moves in straight lines.
Reflection is light bouncing off a surface. The angle of incidence equals the angle of reflection. A plane mirror forms an image of the same size, as far behind the mirror as the object is in front, and left and right are swapped.

problem.en: A girl stands 1 m in front of a mirror. How far is her image from her?

text.en: The image is as far behind the mirror.
1 m behind the mirror, so 2 m from her.

requiredIdeas.en: An opaque object blocks the straight path of light.

points.en: Angle of incidence equals angle of reflection.
Plane mirror image is same size and laterally inverted.
